ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var raw = vars.originalHL7 as String
var decoded = if (trim(raw) startsWith "\"") read(raw, "application/json") as String else raw
var lines = decoded splitBy /\r\n|\n|\r/ var msh = ((lines filter ($ startsWith "MSH|"))[0] default "") splitBy "|" var pid = ((lines filter ($ startsWith "PID|"))[0] default "") splitBy "|" var pv1 = ((lines filter ($ startsWith "PV1|"))[0] default "") splitBy "|"
var patientName = (pid[5] default "") splitBy "^" var patientLocation = (pv1[3] default "") splitBy "^" var patientAddress = (pid[11] default "") splitBy "^"
--- { messageId: msh[9] default "", messageType: msh[8] default "", eventType: ((msh[8] default "") splitBy "^")[1] default "", eventTime: msh[6] default "", version: msh[11] default "",
patientId: ((pid[3] default "") splitBy "^")[0], mrn: ((pid[3] default "") splitBy "^")[0],
firstName: patientName[1] default "", lastName: patientName[0] default "", middleName: patientName[2] default "",
dateOfBirth: pid[7] default "", gender: pid[8] default "",
addressLine1: patientAddress[0] default "", city: patientAddress[2] default "", state: patientAddress[3] default "", postalCode: patientAddress[4] default "", country: patientAddress[5] default "",
contactPhone: ((pid[13] default "") splitBy "^")[0], maritalStatus: pid[16] default "",
encounterId: ((pv1[19] default "") splitBy "^")[0],
ward: patientLocation[0] default "", room: patientLocation[1] default "", bed: patientLocation[2] default "", facility: patientLocation[3] default "",
patientClass: pv1[2] default "", accountNumber: ((pid[18] default "") splitBy "^")[0] }

logger.message: #['Processing HL7 event: ' ++ (vars.hl7Data.eventType as String) ++ ', Message ID: ' ++ (vars.hl7Data.messageId as String)]

set-variable.doc:name: Check Supported HL7 Event
set-variable.value: #[vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A01' or vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A02' or vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A03' or vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A08']

when.expression: #[vars.supportedVersion != true or isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.messageId default '') or isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.patientId default '') or isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.eventTime default '') or vars.supportedEvent != true or (vars.hl7Data.eventType != 'A08' and isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.encounterId default ''))]

set-variable.value: #[if (vars.supportedVersion != true) 'Unsupported HL7 version: ' ++ ((vars.hl7Data.version default 'MISSING') as String) else if (isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.messageId default '')) 'Missing Message ID' else if (isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.patientId default '')) 'Missing Patient ID' else if (isEmpty(vars.hl7Data.eventTime default '')) 'Missing Event Timestamp' else if (vars.supportedEvent != true) 'Unsupported HL7 event' else 'Missing Encounter ID']

db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate
db:select.db:sql: SELECT message_id FROM processed_messages WHERE message_id = :messageId

logger.message: A01 admission blocked due to identity conflict

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Admission
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO encounters ( encounter_id, patient_id, admission_date, ward, room, bed, status, last_event_time, account_number, patient_class, facility ) VALUES ( :encounterId, :patientId, STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), :ward, :room, :bed, 'ADMITTED', STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), NULLIF(:accountNumber, ''), NULLIF(:patientClass, ''), NULLIF(:facility, '') ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ward = IF( status = 'ADMITTED' AND ( last_event_time IS NULL OR last_event_time <= VALUES(last_event_time) ), VALUES(ward), ward ), room = IF( status = 'ADMITTED' AND ( last_event_time IS NULL OR last_event_time <= VALUES(last_event_time) ), VALUES(room), room ), bed = IF( status = 'ADMITTED' AND ( last_event_time IS NULL OR last_event_time <= VALUES(last_event_time) ), VALUES(bed), bed ), account_number = COALESCE( VALUES(account_number), account_number ), patient_class = COALESCE( VALUES(patient_class), patient_class ), facility = COALESCE( VALUES(facility), facility ), last_event_time = GREATEST( COALESCE(last_event_time, VALUES(last_event_time)), VALUES(last_event_time) )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ encounterId: vars.hl7Data.encounterId, patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId, eventTime: vars.hl7Data.eventTime, ward: vars.hl7Data.ward, room: vars.hl7Data.room, bed: vars.hl7Data.bed, accountNumber: vars.hl7Data.accountNumber, patientClass: vars.hl7Data.patientClass, facility: vars.hl7Data.facility }]

db:update.doc:name: Transfer Patient
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE encounters SET ward = :ward, room = :room, bed = :bed, last_event_time = STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') WHERE encounter_id = :encounterId AND patient_id = :patientId AND status = 'ADMITTED' AND ( last_event_time IS NULL OR last_event_time < STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ encounterId: vars.hl7Data.encounterId, patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId, ward: vars.hl7Data.ward, room: vars.hl7Data.room, bed: vars.hl7Data.bed, eventTime: vars.hl7Data.eventTime }]

logger.message: #['A02 transfer applied: ' ++ ((vars.eventApplied default false) as String)]

db:update.doc:name: Discharge Patient
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE encounters SET status = 'DISCHARGED', discharge_date = STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), last_event_time = STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') WHERE encounter_id = :encounterId AND patient_id = :patientId AND status = 'ADMITTED' AND ( last_event_time IS NULL OR last_event_time < STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )

db:select.doc:name: Verify Discharge in TiDB
db:select.db:sql: SELECT encounter_id, patient_id, status, DATE_FORMAT( last_event_time, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s' ) AS event_time_text, DATE_FORMAT( discharge_date, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s' ) AS discharge_time_text FROM encounters WHERE encounter_id = :encounterId AND patient_id = :patientId

set-variable.doc:name: Verify Discharge
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- sizeOf(vars.encounterVerification default []) > 0 and (vars.encounterVerification[0].status default '') == 'DISCHARGED' and (vars.encounterVerification[0].event_time_text default '') == vars.hl7Data.eventTime and (vars.encounterVerification[0].discharge_time_text default '') == vars.hl7Data.eventTime]

logger.message: #['A03 discharge verified: ' ++ ((vars.eventApplied default false) as String)]
A08 update blocked due to patient identity conflict

set-variable.doc:name: Set Event Failure Reason
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (vars.identityConflict default false) (vars.identityConflictReason default 'Patient identity conflict') else if (vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A02') 'Transfer not applied: encounter missing, discharged, or event outdated' else if (vars.hl7Data.eventType == 'A03') 'Discharge not applied: encounter missing, mismatched discharge timestamp, or event outdated' else 'HL7 event could not be applied']

amqp:message.amqp:body: #[output application/json --- { messageId: vars.hl7Data.messageId, eventType: vars.hl7Data.eventType, patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId, encounterId: vars.hl7Data.encounterId, status: "PROCESSED" }]

db:insert.doc:name: Record Processed Message
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processed_messages ( message_id, event_type, patient_id, file_name, message_type, mrn, processing_status, ack_code, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :messageId, :eventType, :patientId, :fileName, :messageType, :mrn, 'PROCESSED', 'AA', :messageId )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ messageId: vars.hl7Data.messageId, eventType: vars.hl7Data.eventType, patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId, fileName: vars.hl7FileName, messageType: vars.hl7Data.messageType, mrn: vars.hl7Data.mrn }]

db:insert.doc:name: Record Duplicate Attempt
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO duplicate_attempts ( message_id, file_name ) VALUES ( :messageId, :fileName )

db:insert.doc:name: Record Quarantined Message
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processed_messages ( message_id, event_type, patient_id, file_name, message_type, mrn, processing_status, ack_code, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :messageId, :eventType, :patientId, :fileName, :messageType, :mrn, 'QUARANTINED', :ackCode, :correlationId ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE processing_status = 'QUARANTINED', ack_code = VALUES(ack_code)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ messageId: vars.hl7Data.messageId default "", eventType: vars.hl7Data.eventType default "", patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId default "", fileName: vars.hl7FileName default "", messageType: vars.hl7Data.messageType default "", mrn: vars.hl7Data.mrn default "", ackCode: vars.ackCode default "AR", correlationId: vars.hl7Data.messageId default "" }]

logger.message: #['HL7 message quarantined: ' ++ ((vars.ackReason default 'Unknown reason') as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Find Existing Patient Identity
db:select.db:sql: SELECT patient_id, first_name, last_name, DATE_FORMAT(date_of_birth, '%Y%m%d') AS dob_text, gender FROM patients WHERE patient_id = :patientId

set-variable.doc:name: Detect Patient Identity Conflict
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var existing = (vars.existingPatient default [])[0] default {} var storedDob = (existing.dob_text default '') as String var incomingDob = (vars.hl7Data.dateOfBirth default '') as String var storedGender = upper((existing.gender default '') as String) var incomingGender = upper((vars.hl7Data.gender default '') as String) --- sizeOf(vars.existingPatient default []) > 0 and ( ( storedDob != '' and incomingDob != '' and storedDob != incomingDob ) or ( storedGender != '' and incomingGender != '' and storedGender != incomingGender ) )]
Patient identity conflict: date of birth or gender does not match existing MRN
set-variable.doc:name: Store Conflict Reason

logger.doc:name: Log Identity Conflict
logger.message: #['Patient identity conflict rejected; messageId=' ++ (vars.hl7Data.messageId as String)]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert or Update Patient
db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO patients ( patient_id, patient_key, mrn, first_name, last_name, middle_name, date_of_birth, gender, address_line1, city, state, postal_code, country, contact_phone, marital_status, last_msg_datetime, last_control_id ) VALUES ( :patientId, :patientKey, :mrn, :firstName, :lastName, NULLIF(:middleName, ''), STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(:dob, ''), '%Y%m%d'), :gender, NULLIF(:addressLine1, ''), NULLIF(:city, ''), NULLIF(:state, ''), NULLIF(:postalCode, ''), NULLIF(:country, ''), NULLIF(:contactPhone, ''), NULLIF(:maritalStatus, ''), STR_TO_DATE(:eventTime, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), :messageId ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
first_name = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), VALUES(first_name), first_name ),
last_name = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), VALUES(last_name), last_name ),
middle_name = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(middle_name), middle_name), middle_name ),
date_of_birth = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(date_of_birth), date_of_birth), date_of_birth ),
gender = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(NULLIF(VALUES(gender), ''), gender), gender ),
address_line1 = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(address_line1), address_line1), address_line1 ),
city = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(city), city), city ),
state = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(state), state), state ),
postal_code = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(postal_code), postal_code), postal_code ),
country = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(country), country), country ),
contact_phone = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(contact_phone), contact_phone), contact_phone ),
marital_status = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), COALESCE(VALUES(marital_status), marital_status), marital_status ),
last_control_id = IF( last_msg_datetime IS NULL OR last_msg_datetime <= VALUES(last_msg_datetime), VALUES(last_control_id), last_control_id ),
last_msg_datetime = GREATEST( COALESCE(last_msg_datetime, VALUES(last_msg_datetime)), VALUES(last_msg_datetime) )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ patientId: vars.hl7Data.patientId, patientKey: "PAT-" ++ vars.hl7Data.patientId, mrn: vars.hl7Data.mrn, firstName: vars.hl7Data.firstName, lastName: vars.hl7Data.lastName, middleName: vars.hl7Data.middleName, dob: vars.hl7Data.dateOfBirth, gender: vars.hl7Data.gender, addressLine1: vars.hl7Data.addressLine1, city: vars.hl7Data.city, state: vars.hl7Data.state, postalCode: vars.hl7Data.postalCode, country: vars.hl7Data.country, contactPhone: vars.hl7Data.contactPhone, maritalStatus: vars.hl7Data.maritalStatus, eventTime: vars.hl7Data.eventTime, messageId: vars.hl7Data.messageId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
var timestamp = now() as String { format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss" }
var code = vars.ackCode default "AE" var reason = (vars.ackReason default "") as String
var safeReason = reason replace /[\r\n|]/ with " "
--- "MSH|^~\\&|MULESOFT|HL7_ROUTER|HOSPITAL|SENDER|" ++ timestamp ++ "||ACK^" ++ (vars.hl7Data.eventType default "A01") ++ "|" ++ uuid() ++ "|P|2.5\r" ++ "MSA|" ++ code ++ "|" ++ (vars.hl7Data.messageId default "UNKNOWN") ++ ( if (isEmpty(safeReason)) "" else "|" ++ safeReason ) ++ "\r"

logger.doc:name: ACK Generated
logger.message: #['HL7 ACK generated in S3. Code: ' ++ ((vars.ackCode default 'AE') as String)]
